-----Original Message-----
From: Lisa Monelli <info@myvilla.la> 
Sent: Thursday, November 19, 2026 6:26 PM
To: hello@canyon-news.com
Subject: A European angle on your Malibu listings piece

 

Hi Canyon News team,

 

(Writing to the Canyon News newsroom rather than Sharon directly — we couldn't locate a direct contact. Feel free to forward if it's a better fit for them or the desk.)

 

Really enjoyed your piece on the Schmidt and Brin Malibu listings — you captured something coastal coverage often skips: how much the value conversation in Malibu now quietly turns on resilience, not just the view.

 

A quick hello from our side: at My Villa, we bring European construction resilience and the Italian way of living to homes in Los Angeles — designed in exposed reinforced concrete, cemento a vista.

 

One thought your piece sparked: the fire and coastal durability standards Malibu is now codifying have been default Mediterranean practice for generations. That cultural gap feels like the real story behind beachfront rebuilding.

 

Would you be interested in receiving more material on what we are doing, or in setting up a short call with our founder Paolo?

 

Best,

Lisa Monelli

My Villa Media Team

 <mailto:info@myvilla.la> info@myvilla.la · myvilla.la
